message:
- Issue with ads not always loading should now be fixed!
- Threshold for offline bonus lowered from 5 minutes to 10 seconds
- Inventory performance has been vastly increased!
- Selling/upgrading items no longer scrolls entire inventory to top
- Current level of item is now properly shown if the item is max level.
- Upgrade icon for each item is no longer removed upon selling an item
- Minor tuning
